say.en: Four properties depend only on the number of solute particles, not on what they are. We call them colligative.
The relative lowering of vapour pressure equals the mole fraction of the solute.
Boiling point rises and freezing point falls in proportion to the molality.
Solvent flows through a semipermeable membrane into the solution. The pressure that stops it is the osmotic pressure.
Example: 18 grams of glucose in 500 grams of water is 0.2 molal. Then delta T b is 0.104 K and delta T f is 0.372 K.
Turned around, any colligative property gives the molar mass of the solute.
